input.command:
cat << 'SCRIPT' | bun - const RESEND_API_KEY = "re_[REDACTED]"; const centreCode = "north-york-on-ca"; const centreDisplayName = "North York"; const fwdAddr = "scott.james1717+north-york-on-ca@gmail.com"; const KB_REFERENCE_URL = "https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QTvkO1d72KYIi2ALtPEIrOASsbxggxeyCRiS1rWK3Ek/edit?usp=sharing"; const code = (text: string) => `${text}`; const html = `

Code Ninjas ${centreDisplayName} — Getting Started

Hi there,

Welcome aboard! Below is a quick summary of your setup, followed by three short steps to get everything connected.

CentreCode Ninjas ${centreDisplayName}
Centre Code${code(centreCode)}
AI Phone NumberWill be assigned after setup
Forwarding Address${code(fwdAddr)}

Step 1: Test Phone Number

To start making calls on your behalf, we need a phone number to use for testing. This should be a number that can receive calls — your personal cell or a staff member's number works great.

Please reply to this email with the 10-digit phone number you'd like us to use for test calls.

Step 2: Email Forwarding

We need Lineleader lead notification emails forwarded to our system so the AI agent knows when a new lead comes in. Pick the option below that matches your setup:

Option A: Personal Email (Outlook)

Choose this if Lineleader emails go to your personal email address and you use Outlook.

Step 1: Open Rules

  1. Open Outlook and go to your Inbox
  2. Click "Rules" in the toolbar (Home tab) → "Manage Rules & Alerts"
  3. Click "New Rule"

Step 2: Set Up the Condition

  1. Select "Apply rule on messages I receive" and click Next
  2. Check "from people or public group" — click the underlined link at the bottom and type: ${code("noreply@lineleader.com")} → click OK
  3. Check "with specific words in the subject" — click the underlined link and type: ${code("New CORE Program Inquiry")} → click Add → OK
  4. Click Next

Step 3: Set Up the Action

  1. Check "forward it to people or public group"
  2. Click the underlined link at the bottom and type: ${code(fwdAddr)} → click OK
  3. Click Next → Next → name the rule "CRM Lead Forwarding"
  4. Click Finish

That's it! Outlook will now automatically forward matching Lineleader emails.

Option B: Shared Centre Inbox (Microsoft 365)

Choose this if Lineleader emails go to a shared mailbox (like northyorkonca@codeninjas.com) that multiple staff members access.

Shared mailboxes don't support simple forwarding rules, so we'll use Power Automate (included free with your Microsoft 365 account).

Step 1: Open Power Automate

  1. Go to https://flow.microsoft.com
  2. Sign in with your Microsoft 365 account (the one that has access to the shared inbox)

Step 2: Create a New Flow

  1. Click "Create" in the left menu
  2. Select "Automated cloud flow"
  3. Name it: ${code("CRM Lead Forwarding")}
  4. Search for the trigger: "When a new email arrives in a shared mailbox (V2)"
  5. Click "Create"

Step 3: Configure the Trigger

  1. In "Original Mailbox Address", enter your shared inbox address
  2. Set "Subject Filter" to: ${code("New CORE Program Inquiry")}
  3. Under "Advanced options": set "From" to: ${code("noreply@lineleader.com")}

Step 4: Add the Forward Action

  1. Click "+ New step"
  2. Search for: "Forward an email (V2)"
  3. Set "Message Id" to the dynamic value "Message Id" from the trigger
  4. Set "To" to: ${code(fwdAddr)}

Step 5: Save and Turn On

  1. Click "Save" in the top right
  2. Make sure the flow shows as "On"

Step 3: Knowledge Base

The AI agent uses a Knowledge Base document to answer questions about your centre (hours, pricing, programs, etc.). You'll create your own copy and customize it with your centre's details.

Step 1: Copy the Reference Document

  1. Open this link: Reference Knowledge Base
  2. Go to File → "Make a copy"
  3. Name it something like "Code Ninjas ${centreDisplayName} — Knowledge Base"
  4. Save it to your own Google Drive

Step 2: Customize It

  1. Open your new copy
  2. Update the highlighted sections with your centre's specific details (hours, pricing, programs, staff names, etc.)
  3. Remove any placeholder text that doesn't apply to your location

Step 3: Share It With Us

  1. Click the "Share" button in the top right
  2. Set access to "Anyone with the link" can view
  3. Copy the link and reply to this email with it

That's everything! Once we have your test phone number and knowledge base link, we'll get your AI agent fully configured and ready for a live demo.

If you have any questions, just reply to this email.

Best regards,
Scott

`; const res = await fetch("https://api.resend.com/emails", { method: "POST", headers: { "Authorization": "Bearer " + RESEND_API_KEY, "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ from: "Poseidon ", to: "scott.james@codeninjas.com", subject: "Code Ninjas North York — Getting Started (Pre-Onboarding)", html }) }); const result = await res.json(); console.log("Status:", res.status); console.log("Response:", JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)); SCRIPT
input.description: Send pre-onboarding email for North York via Resend API
